source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Have We not expanded for you, O Prophet, your chest for the laws of the religion, the call to God, and adorning yourself with noble character, and thereby lifted your burden from you?
tafsir.muyassar-2: Have We not expanded for you, O Prophet, your chest for the laws of the religion, the call to God, and adorning yourself with noble character, and thereby lifted your burden from you?
tafsir.muyassar-3: That weighed heavily on your back, and We placed you, through the noble qualities We bestowed on you, in a high and exalted station?
tafsir.muyassar-4: That weighed heavily on your back, and We placed you, through the noble qualities We bestowed on you, in a high and exalted station?
tafsir.muyassar-5: So do not let the harm of your enemies turn you away from spreading the message; for with hardship comes relief, indeed with hardship comes relief.
tafsir.muyassar-6: So do not let the harm of your enemies turn you away from spreading the message; for with hardship comes relief, indeed with hardship comes relief.
tafsir.muyassar-7: So when you have finished with the affairs and occupations of this world, strive in worship, and turn in longing to your Lord alone for what is with Him.
tafsir.muyassar-8: So when you have finished with the affairs and occupations of this world, strive in worship, and turn in longing to your Lord alone for what is with Him.
